task: Achieve and exceed parity with VoidChecksum/enma-lsp-pcx. Source comparison documented in this conversation; Tier A already shipped before ralph started. This PRD covers Tier B/C/D plus our own differentiators. Source-of-truth rule for predefined sync: append-only — predefined wins, never overwrite existing decls.

stories.title: Tier A regression net — verifier proof Tier A still works
stories.description: Tier A shipped folding ranges, workspace symbols, [[…]] semantic tokens, enma-predefined language id + grammar, and bin/enma-language-server.js launcher. Add mocha tests so the work doesn't regress.
acceptanceCriteria: server/test/unit/services/foldingRange.test.ts exists; covers brace pairs, block comments, line-comment runs, and #region/#endregion markers; ≥4 cases passing
server/test/unit/services/workspaceSymbol.test.ts exists; covers exact / prefix / substring scoring and an empty-query baseline; ≥3 cases passing

server/test/unit/services/semanticTokens.annotations.test.ts exists; verifies a `[[packed]] struct` and a `[[dll("name")]] void f();` emit decorator tokens for the brackets + identifier inside; ≥2 cases passing
bin/enma-language-server.js exists, has the auto-stdio fallback, exits non-zero with a useful message when server/dist/server.js is absent
package.json has bin.enma-language-server pointing at bin/enma-language-server.js
Full server test suite passes (npm test in server/) with no regressions

stories.title: Auto-import code action (vec / color / math3d helpers)
stories.description: Client-side CodeActionProvider that scans the active .em file for names that live in pre-shipped addons and offers a QuickFix to insert the matching `import "…";` after the preamble. Skip already-imported modules. Strip comments and string literals before scanning so doc-comments don't trigger false hits.
acceptanceCriteria: client/src/autoImport.ts exists and exports a CodeActionProvider implementation
Module catalogue includes at minimum: vec (vec2/3/4 + scalar helpers), color (color, color_*), math3d (mat4/quat constructors), and is sourced from a single mapping table so additions are trivial
Provider emits a QuickFix code action when an unimported identifier is used; action inserts `import "<module>";` immediately after the trailing preamble line
Already-imported modules produce no QuickFix
Line comments, block comments, and double-quoted strings are stripped before identifier scanning (no false hits)
client/src/extension.ts registers the provider in activate()
Build clean (npm run compile) and lint clean (npm run lint)

stories.title: Const + stack-escape warning pass
stories.description: Server-side post-pass that walks every NodeFunction body and emits warnings for (a) assignments to const variables, (b) `return &local;` / address-of-local stored into a non-local destination. Mirrors patterns documented at https://enma-1.gitbook.io/enma/language-guide/advanced.
acceptanceCriteria: server/src/compiler_analyzer/escapeAndConstCheck.ts exists; exports a single entry function called from analyzer.ts after the main analyzer pass
Const assignment: `const int32 x = 1; x = 2;` emits a Warning with code 'EN_CONST_WRITE' or equivalent
Stack-escape return: `int32 f() { int32 x = 1; return &x; }` emits a Warning with code 'EN_STACK_ESCAPE'
Stack-escape store to global: `int32* g; void f() { int32 x = 1; g = &x; }` emits the same warning
Local-to-local address-of inside the same function does NOT warn (no false positive)
Warnings use a new analyzerDiagnostic.warning() (or equivalent) helper so the existing severity rollback doesn't escalate/demote them silently
server/test/unit/analyzer/escapeAndConstCheck.test.ts exists with ≥5 cases — at least one positive case per rule and one negative case
TypeScript clean: tsc --noEmit -p server/tsconfig.json — 0 errors
Full server test suite passes

stories.title: enma.bundler.bundleOnSave — debounced auto-rebundle
stories.description: When enma.bundler.bundleOnSave is true, the extension re-runs the active project's bundler ~750ms after any .em save. Debounced; uses the default bundler settings or the first project in enma.projects.
acceptanceCriteria: package.json contributes.configuration adds `enma.bundler.bundleOnSave` (boolean, default false) with a clear description mentioning the debounce window
client/src/bundler.ts (or a sibling module) listens to workspace.onDidSaveTextDocument for .em files and schedules a debounced rebundle when bundleOnSave is true
Multiple saves within the debounce window collapse to a single bundler invocation (verified by manual trace logging in implementation, not test)
Bundler errors surface via window.showErrorMessage; success is silent unless the user has previously opened the output panel
Build + lint clean

stories.title: Multi-project lspMode (full | syntaxOnly)
stories.description: Per-project LSP scope control inside one workspace. `full` enables all IntelliSense; `syntaxOnly` provides only grammar highlighting + parser errors. Useful for reference folders that shouldn't pollute the workspace analyzer.
acceptanceCriteria: enma.projects[].lspMode added to package.json schema (enum: full | syntaxOnly, default full)

Server-side: a single helper hasFullLsp(uri) lives in inspector or a new core/projectScope module; every onHover/onCompletion/onSignatureHelp/onDefinition/onReferences/onRename/onCodeAction/inlayHint handler early-returns when hasFullLsp returns false
Diagnostics in syntaxOnly mode are limited to tokenizer + parser diagnostics (no analyzer diagnostics for files outside `full` projects)

server/test/unit/inspector/lspMode.test.ts covers: file inside `full` project sees full LSP, file inside `syntaxOnly` project gets empty results from hover/completion/definition, file outside all projects defaults to full (preserves single-project behaviour)
Full server test suite passes; lint + tsc clean

stories.title: Docs MCP sync tool — append-only predefined merge
stories.description: scripts/sync-from-docs-mcp.mjs that pulls from the enma-docs and perception-docs MCP servers and merges new declarations into server/src/predefined/{enma-stdlib,perception}.em.predefined. Never overwrites or deletes existing decls (predefined wins); appends new symbols under a dated section header just like VoidChecksum's import-docs.ts. Has a --write flag; default is dry-run.
acceptanceCriteria: scripts/sync-from-docs-mcp.mjs exists; runnable via `npm run sync-docs` after adding to package.json scripts
Reads a docs catalogue JSON at data/docs-catalogue.json (or environment-provided path) so the script itself stays MCP-agnostic and offline-runnable in CI
For each incoming declaration: identifier extracted via the same regex pattern shape as VoidChecksum's import-docs.ts (class/struct/interface, funcdef, function, global var)
Existing identifiers are skipped (not overwritten); new identifiers are appended under a `// ─── Imported via npm run sync-docs <YYYY-MM-DD> ───` header
Default mode prints a human-readable diff; `--write` flag mutates the predefined files in place
scripts/sync-from-docs-mcp.test.mjs (or a sibling mocha spec) exercises the merge function against a fixture catalogue + fixture predefined; verifies append-only semantics
Documentation: docs/docs-mcp-sync.md (or a section in README) explains the workflow, including how to refresh data/docs-catalogue.json from the MCP servers in the dev environment

stories.title: Engine MCP client + Run Script command
stories.description: Talk to a Perception engine-side MCP server at http://127.0.0.1:9077/mcp (default; configurable). Adds an enma.runScript command that POSTs the active .em (bundled if applicable) to the engine via the MCP `script/execute` tool. Engine validation is exposed via `script/validate` as a diagnostic provider.
acceptanceCriteria: package.json adds settings: enma.mcp.enabled (boolean, default false), enma.mcp.endpoint (string, default http://127.0.0.1:9077/mcp), enma.mcp.timeoutMs (number, default 5000), enma.mcp.authToken (string, default empty — optional bearer)
package.json contributes command enma.runScript with title 'Run Script (MCP)' under the Enma category
client/src/mcpClient.ts implements an HTTP/1.1 streamable JSON-RPC client speaking the MCP protocol; gracefully handles connection refused with a single window.showErrorMessage (no toast spam)
client/src/runScript.ts hooks the command: bundles the active project (or uses the open file in single-file mode), POSTs to script/execute, surfaces stdout/stderr in an Output channel
engine-MCP validation: when enma.mcp.enabled, on save the client calls script/validate and translates the response into a separate Diagnostic collection (so it doesn't clobber LSP diagnostics)
Build + lint clean; mcpClient gets at least one unit test that mocks fetch and verifies request payload shape

stories.description: Wire up the debuggers contribution and an attach flow at localhost:27979 by default. Reverses the v1.1 demotion when an upstream DAP server is reachable; falls back to a clear error message when nothing is listening.
acceptanceCriteria: package.json contributes.debuggers includes type 'enma-lsp-dap' (or 'enma-dap'), languages ['enma'], label 'Enma Debugger (DAP)', attach-only configurationAttributes (address, port), initialConfigurations + configurationSnippets pointing at localhost:27979
package.json contributes.breakpoints includes language: 'enma'
package.json activationEvents includes onDebug + onDebugResolve:enma-lsp-dap
client/src/dap.ts registers a DebugAdapterDescriptorFactory that proxies the attach to a TCP socket at the resolved address/port
Falling back to an attach when nothing is listening produces a single readable error in the Debug Console, not a stack trace
docs/dap-gate-decision.md updated (or superseded) with a v1.1+ note that DAP attach has shipped
